threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You call it 'the market' without an article and try to grab a spot in that mad afternoon rush. Only locals know where to find the hidden gems while dodging tourists.
Caught the 37 home and the driver was blasting 90s R&B. Everyone was singing along, even the grumpy guy in the back. Just another night in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy juggling flaming torches at Hermannplatz while waiting for the bus, I knew I’d found home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a Turkish market operating alongside a techno club, where you can grab a döner after a night of dancing. Pure Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only real locals know that the taco truck on 24th is the ultimate hangover cure, while the newcomers still chase brunch lines like it's a sport.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 5 tonight, and we were stopped for ten minutes because a pigeon decided to settle down on the tracks. Only in SF, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but it’s the hidden plaza bars and local art that truly capture the spirit of the neighborhood.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by how they still use their umbrellas on sunny days, convinced that clouds are just around the corner.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You’ll spot the newbies because they still ask for directions to the nearest station, clueless about the 'back roads' shortcuts everyone else knows.
Caught a glimpse of a guy in a sequined jacket singing to his reflection in the bus window. Only in Brixton at 2am, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids playing Fußball in the rain, splashing through puddles while the parents sipped coffee nearby. Surreal and local.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a bar that serves cocktails made from raw ingredients—think beetroot and fresh herbs. It's a whole experience.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they casually stroll past a Muni delay, while newcomers fume and check their phones for updates.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the Muni stuck behind a yoga class doing sun salutations on Market. Only in SF would the train be held up by zen vibes.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's plaça is for selfies, but locals gather for evening chats over vermut, laughing off the noise of the world.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones fumbling with the metro map at Diagonal, oblivious to the fact that locals just glance at their phones. It’s like watching someone try to fit in at a family dinner.
